table_description: Small dimension table (~7,200 rows) representing unique combinations of household characteristics. Each row is a distinct combination of income band, buy potential, dependent count, and vehicle count. Referenced by sales fact tables as HDEMO_SK. Used for household-level demographic segmentation of purchasing behavior.
use_cases: Buy potential correlation with actual spend
Vehicle ownership as a lifestyle spending indicator
data_quality_notes: HD_INCOME_BAND_SK links to INCOME_BAND for the actual income range values.
HD_DEP_COUNT is number of dependents in the household.
HD_VEHICLE_COUNT is number of registered vehicles.

table_columns.name: HD_DEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Referenced by sales fact tables as HDEMO_SK.

table_columns.name: HD_INCOME_BAND_SK
table_columns.description: FK to INCOME_BAND.IB_INCOME_BAND_SK. Links to the household income range.

table_columns.name: HD_BUY_POTENTIAL
table_columns.description: Estimated annual household buying potential bucket: '>10000', '5001-10000', '1001-5000', '501-1000', '0-500', 'Unknown'.

table_columns.name: HD_DEP_COUNT
table_columns.description: Number of dependents in the household.

table_columns.name: HD_VEHICLE_COUNT
table_columns.description: Number of registered vehicles in the household.
